name: Form pony

unlock.how: found in the bug report form

tips: A good bug report says what you did, what you expected, and what happened instead.
Write the steps to make the bug happen again. A bug the developer can repeat gets fixed.
Paste error messages in full, as text. The exact words help people search for the cause.
personal: Steps, expected, actual. Then the bug has nowhere to hide.
Thank you for reporting! Every bug report makes the game better.
